1722-2034-3583-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6720.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5147-5662--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 5.

4067-5078-7729-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat

2232-7827-7832-7835.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7832-7835.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-2265-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Hardened Scales
Repeat.

1778-2626-4986-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Memnite.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-5223.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2079-4289-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2079-4289-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2079-4289-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-5902-6774.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Loading Zone and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3197-6720-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6720-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

372-4598-7095.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4598-7095.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Chakra Meditation and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Chakra Meditation's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Chakra Meditation trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Chakra Meditation and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

232-1235-5026-6927.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Damage Control Crew.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Damage Control Crew with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Damage Control Crew tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4506-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4506-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wylie Duke with "Kraken" chosen

413-1238-2351-5467-7040.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability
Repeat.

2292-5220-5708-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

856-1379-4050-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1414-2866-4986-5231.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Spider you control without summoning sickness
attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

1729-2178-4395.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Lightning Prowess attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1543-2047-4231-5469-6717.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Academy Manufactor.
When the Academy Manufactor token enters the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers, putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Transmutation Font by tapping it, creating three Food, Clue and Treasure tokens.
When the tokens enter the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers nine times, putting nine loyalty counters on it.
Activate Tezzeret using the ability granted to it by Ichormoon Gauntlet by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Academy Manufactor.
When the Academy Manufactor token enters the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers, putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Transmutation Font by tapping it, creating nine Food, Clue and Treasure tokens.
When the tokens enter the battlefield, Tezzeret triggers 27 times, putting 27 loyalty counters on it.
Activate Tezzeret using the ability granted to it by Ichormoon Gauntlet by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Academy Manufactor and causing you to win the game.
1543-2047-4231-5469-6717.notes: You can continually make more Academy Manufactors each turn, which will progressively give you more Clues, Foods and Treasures each turn.

3000-5670-6273.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-6273.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

1486-4091-4452.notablePrerequisites:
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-4091-4452.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

539-1636-4336-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
539-1636-4336-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control another nontoken creature without summoning sickness, this combo nets infinite mana creatures you control can produce.

1308-1558-3775.notablePrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You have completed a dungeon.
1308-1558-3775.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Safana triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasure tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

419-1705-2754-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Backslide without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Backslide, turning Brine Elemental face down.
Activate Ixidor by paying {2}{U}, turning Brine Elemental face up.
Brine Elemental triggers, causing each opponent to skip their next untap step.
Repeat during each of your turns.

190-1321-1632.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Immortal Coil and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Activate Stonespeaker Crystal's second ability by paying {2}, tapping it and sacrificing it, exiling all cards from each opponent's graveyard and causing you to draw a card.
Each opponent's Immortal Coil triggers, causing them to lose the game.

528-3644-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Young Wolf does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
528-3644-4929-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Young Wolf.
Young Wolf's undying ability triggers, returning Young Wolf from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters the battlefield triggering Corpse Knight, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Young Wolf, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling token enters the battlfield triggering Corpse Knight, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

640-2018-4050-5197.description:
Activate Downdraft by paying {G}, causing Luminous Broodmoth to lose flying until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth, adding {G}.
Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat.
